features.label: Recovered dust distribution
features.description: Broad red, green and blue structures combine gas, cold dust and warmer dust across the dwarf galaxy.

explanation: Herschel resolved fine dust but missed some diffuse emission; Planck, IRAS and COBE help restore a more complete distribution.
colorMethod: Red indicates hydrogen gas, green cold dust and blue warmer dust. These are assigned physical layers.
